name: fb1_sensor

parts.source: Honeywell FMA data sheet 32347833, Figure 3 recommended land pattern and Table 6, reviewed 2026-10-11

parts.value: 1uF 16V X7R; effective capacitance to be verified

wire_port_assignment.1: Pico 3V3 OUT, physical pin 36; power drive
wire_port_assignment.2: Pico GND, physical pin 38; return drive
wire_port_assignment.3: Pico GP4 / I2C0 SDA, physical pin 6
wire_port_assignment.4: Pico GP5 / I2C0 SCL, physical pin 7
wire_port_assignment.5: ADS1115 A0; separate remote supply-sense wire, 100k to controller ground
wire_port_assignment.6: ADS1115 A1; separate remote ground-sense wire, 100k to controller 3V3

controller.bus_pullups: Use the ADS1115 breakout's 10k pullups to 3V3. Verify rise time with the actual cable at 100 kHz; do not power the breakout at 5 V.

limits: This is a digital prototype, not a tested physical PCB.
The six cable wires include separate remote voltage observations. The two supply nets join on the sensor board; this is not a precision four-terminal force transducer.
The vent is open and must not be filled with solder, flux, adhesive or encapsulant.
Solder leads from the back of the wiring tab, with strain relief on the fixed carrier. Do not fit a tall connector on the component face.
Use an insulating film beneath the supported PCB region and verify flat support and the unobstructed vent.
Supply and status checks cannot prove contact coupling, calibration, wire immunity or complete fault coverage.
